description: Offline non-live evidence-status snapshot for future linear encoder readiness unknowns and blockers. This file is documentation/data only and is not a hardware test procedure.

blockers.title: Encoder part selection is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record selected encoder model evidence for both axes, resolution evidence, and output signal type evidence before treating encoder readiness as known.

blockers.title: Encoder mechanical integration is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record reviewed mounting surfaces, readhead clearance, scale alignment constraints, and travel-clearance evidence before treating mechanical integration as known.

blockers.title: Encoder signal and cabling plan is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record cable routing, shielding or spacing, index/reference signal handling, and counter input mapping evidence before enabling encoder readout work.

blockers.title: Encoder-to-image calibration is not evidence-backed
blockers.resolution_evidence_required: Record axis sign, coordinate transform, and image-coordinate calibration evidence before using encoder counts as coordinate truth.
